errors.text_span: + SFT on D₀, D₁" (light purple with diagonal stripes)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns diagonal stripes to "+ SFT on D₀, D₁". The figure shows slanted stripes for this condition, not diagonal stripes.

errors.text_span: + SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" (solid pink)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly labels the color for "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" as solid pink. The figure shows a peach (light red/orange) color for this condition.
The description states 83% for LLaMA-2-70B under "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂", but the figure shows a value close to 80%.

errors.text_span: Each model has four bars representing different training conditions
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly describes the bars as grouped rather than stacked. The figure shows stacked bars, not separate bars.
The description does not mention the white diagonal stripes for "no SFT" (blue) or white horizontal stripes for "+ SFT on D₀" (yellow).
The description omits the tick interval (10) on the y-axis.

errors.text_span: The chart suggests that both scaling up the model size and expanding the SFT dataset contribute to improved performance.
errors.evidence: The description introduces an interpretation not explicitly shown in the figure, violating the atom checklist's requirement for objective description.

errors.text_span: For all three model scales, performance generally increases with the addition of SFT data
